items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow, ruled OUT; X-rays negative, no fracture; expected to miss time (prior similar injury ~1 month). Additional testing Monday.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on final play of first half; carted off.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; backup QB elevated opportunity.
items.opportunity: Commanders pass game without dual-threat Daniels.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, carted off in 4th quarter, ruled out for remainder; MRI Monday. Seen walking with slight limp postgame.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring on scramble; awkward fall.
items.implication: Potential multi-week absence depending on grade; Bears offense impacted.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps; WR/TE targets if limited.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible); previously GTD with optimism.
items.implication: Full or near role expected with docks possible.

items.text: RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); not expected. Grab Jonah Coleman as beneficiary.
items.why: Hamstring; ETR/Levitan projected look at backup.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes yesterday; 36-12 opportunities through 2 weeks. Tucker active no snaps.
items.why: Clear lead back role postgame data.
items.implication: Irving RB1 locked; Gainwell handcuff only.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished in playing time; NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
Eagles RB Saquon Barkley stinger, Q to return mid-game but played through it; MRI today with hope it's minor.
items.why: Stinger in game; returned and finished.
items.implication: Monitor MRI; if minor, full go next week.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time decision; different from prior psoas.
items.implication: If out, TE/ other WR bump (Mumpfield etc).
items.opportunity: LAR pass game redistribution if inactive.

items.text: Michael Pittman OUT (foot); expect look at Germie Bernard.
items.implication: IND WR targets redistribute; Bernard stash YAC fit.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: 27%/38% target shares first two games; leads WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points.

items.text: Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
Raiders HC on Brock Bowers: 'Close, very close. He looks great.' to returning.
Chris Olave (hamstring) expected to play/clean no docks; Joe Burrow (back) expected/active.
items.why: Reports clean for Olave; Burrow active.
